test_title: PYST 24 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

The coach told the athletes that they had been training hard all season and deserved a break.

options.text: The coach said, "You were training hard all season and deserved a break."
The coach told the athletes, "You had been training hard all season and deserved a break."
The coach said to the athletes, "You have been training hard all season and deserved a break."
The coach told the athletes, "They had been training hard all season and deserved a break."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The coach told the athletes that they had been training hard all season and deserved a break.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"they had been training hard" becomes "You have been training hard"**
 
 
• Pronoun "they" is changed to "you" to match the direct address.
 
• Verb tense "had been training" is converted to "have been training" to fit the direct speech context.
 
 
 
• **"deserved a break" remains unchanged.**
 
 
• Maintains the same idea while fitting into the direct speech format.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "told"
 
• Converted to: "told the athletes" to preserve the clarity of the speaker and audience in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "You" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“**The coach said to the athletes, "You have been training hard all season and deserved a break.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The coach said, ‘You were training hard all season and deserved a break.’" 

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "were training" instead of "have been training" changes the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The coach told the athletes, ‘You had been training hard all season and deserved a break.’" 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "had been training" does not match the implied present relevance of the speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The coach told the athletes, ‘They had been training hard all season and deserved a break.’" 
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: "They" does not reflect direct speech addressing the athletes directly as "You."
